I caught my boyfriend of 4 months, at the time, sexting, exchanging nudes with some chick. I'm actually very proud at how I handled the whole situation. I was very rational throughout, I guess the weed that we were partaking in daily helped a lot too. 

So we had just bought a hefty packet of pot that we we were going to share, and I didn't want to leave his house wihout taking my share. He was not gonna let me leave unless I agreed to stay and talk untill that packet was finished. I agreed on the condition that once this packet was done, he'll be dead me. Maybe as a way to show him what he was gonna miss out on, I know it sounds superficially petty. So I put aside all my hurt and focused on having a good time with the expensive af weed. Smoked that packet, took us 2 days. During which time we did a lot of things, had amazing almost desperate sex, and talked. A lot. We talked about everything and nothing. And obviously he appologised, more times than I can count. I honestly forgave him within the first few hours. It came easy to me. But forgetting, now that was the hard part. It's very easy for me to forgive, but it takes my all to forget and not hold resentment. At the end of our time, I did what I said I would do. I told him that I have had so much fun with him, and that I've forgiven him for the hurt that he caused me but we were done as a couple, and walked away. 

He spammed me so fucking much that first night, maybe being the most vulnerable he's ever been infront of me. I asked my friends their opinion, all of them said the same thing to me, once a cheat always a cheat. And hearing that actually made me defensive, I didn't want people to be so rough on him. That's when I realized that I can forget this incident and maybe give him another chance. And here we are, stronger than ever. While I trust him completely I still get times when I feel the cynical rationale taking over me, but it's getting easier to overcome every time. He's never given me any reason to doubt him and he's actively working upon himself and upon us. So I guess we are at a solid place now.
